content:
op doesn't have Winkle and no Castor either, so it'd be a waste to bench him without a dedicated team💔 It's not so much a "Pollux belongs on this team" but more a last resort "man it'd be a waste to not add him *somewhere*" however looking back, Tulu would have more synergy to scale shattered counter higher + weakness + keyflare! 4x wardens feels a bit overkill (but again, it's all personal preference!! If slow and steady 4 wardens is the preferred playstyle, that's valid too! But dzone has a trend of punishing longer/stalled battles so I worry for the current counter team not hitting the dps check and gaining many symptom cards from gaze turns)

My own counter team looks quite different as an e12 Caecus and lv70 Wanda with BiS equips can output tons of active damage along with counter and higher scaling, but a new/low invested team only relying on counter will have a Long Grind once astral enemies reach gaze turns...<:Fkeeper_flop:1356053072924774421>
